registry.name: Applied Intelligence Project Registry
registry.purpose: Central index of Applied Intelligence ecosystem projects, shared references, and source relationships.

projects.name: Applied Intelligence
projects.role: Parent ecosystem and central source hub
projects.notes: Acts as the master database/reference point for agents, schemas, routing, roadmap, website references, and app references.

projects.name: Applied Intelligence Website
projects.role: Website delivery layer for ecosystem presentation and storytelling
projects.notes: Should reference the master source file and project registry so the site stays tied to the ecosystem source of truth.

projects.name: Applied Intelligence App
projects.role: App delivery layer for connected workflows, dashboards, reports, and AI-Connect functions
projects.notes: Should reference the master source file and project registry so the app stays tied to the ecosystem source of truth.
